file.@1:
Life’s never easy, right? But at least I got many friends around here! That helped a lot since even with many people coming to the shelter, no one decided to give me my own home for about two years.

Then came that year… First, I heard someone would finally take me home after the holidays. I usually don’t like the fireworks at all, especially new year’s ones, but this time I didn’t bother!
